summary:
Agentic AI is a hot topic, but its true investment cost remains unclear due to a lack of best practices. How is your organization handling this? How detailed is your cost tracking? When do you implement controls to manage spending without hindering innovation? Join us to explore what works—and what doesn’t—in understanding and managing Agentic AI costs. Through active participation, we’ll co-create practical tools like input factor lists, value equations, and cost management principles. To kickstart our discussion, please reflect on the questions below before the session. Your insights will shape our conversation, and you’ll receive a customized resource afterward to support your continued success.

Why is this so hard? What do you think is at the heart of this challenge?

In what ways have you succeeded in measuring the true cost of Agentic AI?

What would you like to learn from others?
